node_domain: closed rational box intersected with the closed descending order cone
order_tighten: l_i=max_{j>=i}l_j; u_i=min_{j<=i}u_j; discard only if some l_i>u_i
anchor: exact midpoint of the tightened box; no off-S2 or off-S3 filter
split_rule: longest positive width; ties choose smallest coordinate index; exact midpoint; both children closed; tighten each child
queue_rule: unique main scheduler; breadth-first by (depth,node_id); root r, closed lower child suffix0, closed upper child suffix1
child_cutoff_rule: inherit parent's current cutoff index; never switch to a smaller a merely because the whole-box bound failed
center_rule: F_lower>target: whole-box check; F_upper<target: next predeclared smaller a; otherwise stop unresolved
whole_box_rule: same model/window/anchor value plus all five face gradients; fixed Q=I5/32; all 32 corners of the full tightened box
last_cutoff_strict_failure: retain blocked leaf, stop unresolved; no unregistered smaller a and no claim that full G fails
center_pass_box_failure: split deterministically, preserve coverage; no cutoff change at this node
singleton_box_failure: retain blocked leaf and stop unresolved

future_first_batch.feedback: after every completed native attempt and on every stop; batch budget exhaustion preserves queue
future_first_batch.note: 8 total native reservations is a conservative proposed short-feedback cap; main must separately release the actual batch

formal_test_topics: order-tightening exact finite-grid identity and idempotence
true emptiness and tie/zero boundary retention
midpoint and exact rational native-input encoding
longest-axis split and closed seam union
unique BFS queue and single inflight reservation
strict-center cutoff ladder and overlap/last-cutoff stop
center-pass whole-box-failure split with inherited cutoff
same-model/window/center/box adapter and rejection of artificial provenance
passed leaf immutability and coverage frontier accounting
immutable snapshot chain and inflight recovery without relaunch
tamper/stale/duplicate rejection and finite batch reservation budget
retry_policy: no automatic retry, replay, precision increase or hidden extra kernel
resume_policy: inflight reservation survives restart; observe only recorded original handle or import its original completed receipt; unknown orphan stops without dispatch
input_identity: immutable registration/source/theory/audit pins plus canonical exact per-attempt input hash
derivative_gate: main must accept F061 independent true-gradient crosscheck before any future production release or promotion of conditional boxes
reuse_061: no old 061 seed recomputation and no initial 061 leaf import; 061 sealed files remain unchanged
